question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
delta_reason: The sixth round of Oman-mediated talks was scheduled for June 15 but was canceled (not merely postponed) after Israeli strikes on multiple Iranian targets on June 13-14 triggered a US-brokered standdown. MOU framework conditions were exchanged in writing around June 12-16 with Pakistan as facilitating intermediary, but no publicly confirmed HELD session between named US and Iranian principals/envoys occurred before EOD 2026-06-16. The MOU itself was signed digitally by Trump and Pezeshkian on June 17 — one day after the resolution window. Per the ambiguity_rule: written-message exchanges and text circulation are NOT a convened session. Pakistan PM Sharif's June 14 announcement is an MOU announcement, not a confirmed held negotiating session. RESOLVE-NO.
resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension.
resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

question: Will a TIER1-confirmed convened US-Iran negotiating session occur before EOD 2026-06-24?
delta_reason: On June 21, 2026, a formally convened US-Iran negotiating session opened at the Buergenstock resort in Switzerland, hosted by Qatar and Pakistan as named mediators. US delegation led by Vice President JD Vance with Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner; Iran delegation led by Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf. The session ran approximately 18 hours and concluded June 22 with a joint roadmap statement issued by mediators Qatar and Pakistan. Confirmed by Al Jazeera, NBC News, CNBC, NPR, Fox News, CBS News — meets TIER1 multi-source threshold. Technical working groups (Sanctions, Nuclear Affairs, Reconstruction, Monitoring) established. RESOLVE-YES.
resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar), between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.
resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Axios/Al Jazeera/Times of Israel; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also qualifies.
ambiguity_rule: Mere relay of written messages, or one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

Iran MFA statement lifting the June 1 suspension

question: Will a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange (strikes both ways) occur in any 48h window before EOD 2026-06-24?
delta_reason: The bilateral Israel-Iran missile exchange occurred June 7-8 — before F3's observation window opened June 10. Within the June 10-24 window, no confirmed two-directional exchange between Israel and Iran occurred. Israel conducted strikes in Lebanon (Beirut suburbs, June 14), and Iran prepared a response that US intervention preempted; no Iranian missiles struck Israeli territory and no IDF strikes hit Iranian territory after June 10. The ceasefire held through June 24. Per the ambiguity_rule: one-directional Israeli strikes on Lebanese/Hezbollah targets without Iranian counter-strike within 48h = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. RESOLVE-NO.
resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange — Israeli strikes on Iranian targets AND Iranian strikes on Israeli/Israeli-claimed targets — within any rolling 48h window between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.
resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/CNN/Al Jazeera) OR one TIER1 + official Israeli (IDF) or Iranian (IRGC) statement.
ambiguity_rule: Proxy-only attacks (Hezbollah/Houthi) without direct Iran-Israel state strikes do NOT count; one-directional strikes within the 48h window = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: IDF + IRGC reciprocal strike statements within 48h
TIER1 confirmation of two-way strikes in a single window

question: Will mine-countermeasure clearing operations actively commence in Hormuz before EOD 2026-07-10?
delta_reason: CENTCOM announced commencement of mine-clearance operations in the Strait of Hormuz on April 11, 2026, with USS Frank E. Petersen Jr. (DDG 121) and USS Michael Murphy (DDG 112) starting mine-clearance conditions; underwater drones followed. Confirmed by CENTCOM press release, Naval News, Defense Scoop, and The Hill. F5 resolution criteria states 'actively commence in Hormuz before EOD 2026-07-10' — MCM operations are confirmed as ongoing within the resolution window. The Switzerland round June 21-22 explicitly discussed a coordination mechanism for demining the strait (Vance statement). Creation-date note: commencement preceded F5's creation (April 11 vs June 10 creation); this is an oversight-at-creation and does not constitute grounds for NO — operations confirmed active within the June 10-July 10 window. RESOLVE-YES.
resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports mine-countermeasure vessels/operations have actively commenced clearing the Strait of Hormuz (US/coalition/third-party) between 2026-06-10 and 2026-07-10.
resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Bloomberg/CNBC, or a named US/UK/coalition naval/Pentagon statement carried by TIER1.
